result.reason: The redline appropriately assigns Deliverables to Customer and preserves Customer ownership of Customer Data and Vendor ownership of Vendor Technology. However, Section 14.3 only incorporates an unspecified “perpetual licence” from Section 13.2; the supplied operative language does not establish that the licence to embedded Vendor Technology is irrevocable and royalty-free, as required. It also does not expressly clarify that retained Vendor Technology is pre-existing IP. The margin comment cannot cure these omissions. Otherwise, the changes are targeted and professionally drafted.
